WITH filtered_date AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk 
    FROM date_dim 
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
)
SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, 
       COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
       cd_purchase_estimate, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt2,
       cd_credit_rating, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt3
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk AND ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
LEFT JOIN store_sales ss ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN web_sales ws ON c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_sales cs ON c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_ship_customer_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
